question: Which of the following mountain peaks is located in the Karakoram Range?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **K2** is the second-highest mountain in the world, after Mount Everest.
 
• It is located in the **Karakoram Range**, which spans the borders of Pakistan, India, and China.
